name: shinobi-rpg
description: Run the private persistent Shinobi RPG campaign through its authenticated MCP service.

interface.shortDescription: Safely operate the supported Shinobi campaign slice.
interface.longDescription: Loads bounded live campaign context, narrates persisted scenes, reads permitted people, previews and commits supported time or existing-mission commands, and keeps OOC audits separate from campaign state through the private Shinobi RPG MCP service.
defaultPrompt: Show my current Shinobi RPG situation and supported actions.
Advance campaign time until the next player decision.
OOC: audit the campaign for possible improvements.
